<!-- pr-reviewer: 3af6e765923178d31c1d7363195abcb5429f7f35 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one test gap, one body gap; the fix itself is right).

**What looks good**
- `crates/app/src/mcp/fixture_tools.rs:82` runs `crate::pick::check_pickable` on each mate side before `Locate::new`, the same function `pick_of` uses (`crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs:77`). Refusal happens before any command is created, so nothing changes on refusal.
- Searched `crates/app/src/mcp/` for other id-taking parameters: only `pick_of` (via `picks_of`: align, area, set-geometry) and `locate_part` parse feature ids. WCS and setup tools take words, not ids. Vise, plate, modvise, accessory, pockets and probe tools take no feature ids. No remaining bypass.
- The "What a click picks" section matches the code: Alt+click picks one segment (`crates/ui/src/feature_click.rs:61`), Edge mode falls back to the face (`feature_click.rs` `ask`), and the viewport sends `through: false` (`feature_click.rs:117`). The site TOC is generated from headings, so no front matter or nav change is needed.
- `mcp_pick.rs` is 375 lines; no snapshot PNG changed; decision file present; `Refs #692` with no closing keyword.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/tests/mcp_pick.rs` (`locate_part_refuses_a_mate_point_no_click_could_pick`, the test ends about line 375): it asserts the refusal text only. Add (a) an assertion that the document is unchanged after the refusal (e.g. `list_features`/`get_model` output or the undo depth before and after), and (b) a pickable mate (a flat face of the boss on a fixture face) that succeeds, so the check is shown not to refuse everything.
2. PR body: the issue (#692, "Done means" and point 2 of "What should happen") asks for a "pick through" mode the user can turn on, off by default. The PR body only says none is offered in the viewport. List it as still owed, with the decision record's reason, so the issue is not closed on this PR by mistake.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Not verified by me: that the new test fails with the fix removed. The author reports it fails with the fix stashed; I did not re-run that.
- `check_pickable` returns Ok for an unknown model or an unknown vertex id (`crates/app/src/pick/feature_sel.rs:98-101`); the command then refuses it by its own check, so this is fine.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main bdd29e00; target dir per-review)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_pick` | 4 passed |
| `--test feature_pick` | 7 passed |
| `--test feature_pick_wire` | 4 passed, 1 ignored (timing lane) |
| `--test mcp_setup` | 6 passed |
| `--test fixture_locate_stock` | 3 passed |
| `--test mcp_self_centering_vise` | 1 passed |
| `--test mcp_mod_vise` | 1 passed |
| `--test fixture_plate_detect` | 3 passed |
| `--test fixture_keys_lenient` | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- one_pick_rule` (CWD crates/ui) | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the `--ignored` lanes, the release tier, the snapshot suites, the full camcraft-app suite.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
